'''Drall Library''' was a library in the city [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stronghold during the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]].
